title: Aerated Brazilian Kabocha Wrap
description: Rich, aerated, indulgent Brazilian dish featuring kabocha, knead, and Buddhist-temple-friendly corn-husk wrap. Perfect for a delightful vegetarian meal.

ingredients.name: Corn husk wrap
ingredients.notes: soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: Pierce the kabocha squash multiple times with a fork, then bake for 45 minutes, or until tender.
Scoop out the flesh of the kabocha squash, and mash in a bowl with a fork until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together coconut milk, lime juice, ghee, ginger, black pepper, and salt.
Add the mashed kabocha squash to the coconut milk mixture, and stir until well combined.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat, and add the coconut milk mixture. Cook, stirring frequently, for 10-12 minutes, or until the mixture is heated through and slightly thickened.
To assemble the wraps, lay a corn husk flat on a work surface, and spread a quarter of the kabocha mixture down the center of the husk, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Add a sprinkle of chopped cilantro and sliced almonds, if using, on top of the kabocha mixture.
Fold the bottom edge of the corn husk up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a neat cylinder. Repeat with the remaining ingredients, and serve immediately
